messages:
claire: Quick design sync  I pushed a new Figma frame for prompt-set evals. Trying a compact list with collapsible rows + a bulk-approve sheet. Main asks: SR behavior, keyboard shortcuts, and how we surface provenance without loading 200 details at once. Thoughts?

miguel: Compact list + collapse sounds right. Avoid multi-column grids for keyboard/SR. Each row header should be a native <button aria-expanded> to keep semantics clear. Up/Down to move, Enter/Space to toggle.

sam: Agree. Add a dense toggle for power users. Dense still needs visible labels not color-only (OK/FL) + icons. Also add a top-line diff summary when expanded: "3 additions 3 removals" so you don't need to tab tokens.

yuki: Diff highlight nit: current inline <ins>/<del> reflows. Prefer overlay highlights. Example CSS idea for overlay (no animation):
```
.diff-token { position: relative; }
.diff-token::after { content: ''; position: absolute; inset: 0; background: rgba(255,235,59,0.12); pointer-events: none; }
```
Make tokens tabindex=0 and add data-change="added|removed" for SR text.

toni: Bulk-approve: select rows -> open confirmation sheet listing selected count + condensed rows. Do NOT render full provenance for all items. Lazy-load per-item provenance on expand inside the sheet. Sheet must trap focus and be dismissible via Esc. Include an optional comment box and a "notify owners" toggle.

claire: Good. Accessibility: add an aria-live polite region for provenance load progress ("Loaded 20 of 120 items"). Also when filters change update result count in an aria-live region: "Showing 42 results".

miguel: Keyboard extras: J/K to move rows, A to toggle select-all (announce via aria-live), F to focus filters. Home/End should jump to first/last row. Left arrow collapse, Right arrow expand per WAI-ARIA grid/accordion patterns.

sam: Copy proposal: single-row CTA = "Approve", bulk CTA = "Approve selected". Modal confirmation copy: "Approving will record reviewer and timestamp. This action is auditable." Tooltip on approve: "Records reviewer & timestamp" with aria-describedby.

yuki: Motion: respect prefers-reduced-motion. If we animate height for collapse, provide an instant fallback for reduced-motion users. Also avoid long diff highlight transitions.

toni: Performance: when the bulk sheet is opened with many items, show a condensed list of filenames + status and a single-line spinner for each lazily-loading provenance. Do progressive reveal to avoid a huge synchronous render. Announce each batch load via the aria-live region.

claire: UX detail: make the chevron button focusable separately from the row selection checkbox. Checkbox toggles selection, chevron toggles expand. Ensure tab order: checkbox -> row button -> actions.

miguel: For screenreaders, ensure expanded region has role=region and aria-labelledby linking back to the header so SR users hear context when they jump into details.

sam: Diff token SR text suggestion: when focused, read "token text, added" or "token text, removed". Implement via aria-label or aria-describedby that includes the data-change value.

yuki: Also add an overall diff summary button at top of the expanded area that, when activated, focuses the first changed token; useful for keyboard users to jump into changes.

toni: QA checklist: Up/Down, Home/End, Enter/Space toggles, Left/Right collapse, modal focus trap, aria-expanded states, live regions announce counts/provenance loads, reduced-motion respected.
